arStrings.szText: The {c_important}Avalanche{/c} Key Passive now reduces the cost of {c_important}Frost{/c} Skills by an additional {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|%|]{/c} and its damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies is increased to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100 + 25|%x|]{/c}.
